content: “Patohwanohng mehn Israel kan re en kihong uhk sokon ehk riapwoat, apwoat sang rehn kaunen ar kadaudok kan. Ke ahpw ntingihedi eden emenemen kauno ni eh sokon
oh pil ntingihedi eden Aaron ni sokon en Lipai. Emenemen kaunen kadaudok kan pahn ahneki apwoat sokon.
Ke ahpw wahla ni Impwal me I pahn kin ketiket loale oh kihdiong mwohn Kohpwahn Inowo, wasa I kin tuhwong uhk ieo.
Eri sokon en aramas me I piladahr pahn masalpeseng. Ih duwen met ei pahn katokihedi en mehn Israel kan ar kin lipahnedihiuk.”
Moses eri patohwanohng mehn Israel ko, oh emenemen kaun ahpw kihong ar sokon kan, ehu sang ehu kadaudok, eri koaros patpene me ehk riapwoat, oh en Aaron eh sokon pil iang patehng.
Moses eri patohwandiong nan Impwalo sokon ko koaros mwohn Kohpwahn Inowo.

Mandahsang rahno ni en Moses eh patohla nan Impwalo, e kilangada duwen en Aaron eh sokono, me wiliandi kadaudok en Lipai, eh masalpesengehr. E mpwekda, masalpeseng oh kapwarehda wahn almond kei me mahier.
Moses eri ale sokon ko koaros oh wahiei oh kasalehiong mehn Israel ko. Re kilangehr dahme pweidahr oh emenemen ahpw ale uhdahn eh sokon.

KAUN-O ahpw mahsanihong Moses, “Kapwurediong en Aaron sokonen mwohn Kohpwahn Inowen. Pwe en nekinek men pwe en wia mehn kapar ong mehn Israel me kahngohdi kan, pwe re en katokihedi ar lipahned kan; pwe ma soh, re pahn mehla.”
Moses eri wiahda nin duwen KAUN-O eh mahsanih.
Mehn Israel ko eri patohwanohng Moses, “Eri ih pahn imwilaht met!
Mehmen me pahn keiwohng mpen Impwalo eh pahn kamakamala, eri kitail koaruhsie pahn mehla!”
